claim: Hoge Kempen National Park has nine gateways including Terhills, Kattevennen, Station As, Lieteberg, Pietersheim, Mechelse Heide, Thorpark, Duinengordel and Bergerven (some still under development).
quote: Terhills (Maasmechelen) ... Kattevennen (Genk) ... As Railway Station (As) ... Lieteberg (Zutendaal) ... Pietersheim (Lanaken) ... Mechelse Heide (Maasmechelen) ... Thorpark ... Duinengordel ... Bergerven

claim: Mechelse Heide gateway (Joseph Smeetslaan 280, 3630 Maasmechelen) has seven hiking loops, a 1.5km wheelchair-accessible Zandloperpad through a former sand quarry, a dedicated dog play area, kids' Beestige Boelbos and KIDSAFARI, but no visitors' lounge — 'Nature speaks for itself'.
quote: Address: Joseph Smeetslaan 280, 3630 Maasmechelen ... Seven hiking loops originate from this gateway ... Zandloperpad (Sandpiper Path) is a 1.5km wheelchair-accessible paved track ... there is no visitors' lounge here. Nature speaks for itself!

claim: The Mechelse Heide panorama point sits at 104 metres above sea level, the highest spot in the National Park, with views on a clear day as far as Germany and the High Fens.
quote: 104 meters above sea level ... enormous views here as far as the Netherlands and in clear weather even as far as Germany and the High Fens ... the highest point in the National Park

claim: Kattevennen (Planetariumweg 19, Genk) offers a 150-space car park with 2 EV chargers and space for 12 mobile homes; the gateway is open year-round Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and Sun 13:00–17:00, with Saturday 13:00–17:00 added 1 April–31 October.
quote: open all year from Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and on Sunday from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. From April 1st to October 31st, it is also open on Saturdays ... large car park of 150 parking spaces and space for 12 mobile homes ... 2 charging stations

claim: Kattevennen is themed around stars and planets, anchored by the Cosmodrome planetarium and offering six hiking loops (four starting at the gate) plus cycling, MTB, horse riding, mini-golf and a playground.
quote: gateway to your Cosmic-Adventure with Cosmodrome ... 6 hiking loops, with four starting from the entrance gate ... hiking, cycling, mountain biking, horse riding, mini-golf and romping on the playground

claim: Station As gateway (Stationsstraat 124, 3665 As) features a 31m André-Dumont-derrick replica viewing tower, an experience train, a 1,300m miniature narrow-gauge train, forest golf and disc golf; visitor centre open 1 April–8 November, Tue–Sun 09:30–17:00.
quote: 31-meter tall lookout tower ... replica of the derrick with which André Dumont discovered the first coal in Limburg ... 1,300-metre-long narrow gauge track ... April 1st–November 8th, Tuesday–Sunday, 9:30 AM–12:00 PM and 12:30 PM–5:00 PM

claim: Lieteberg's signature attraction is a ~3km barefoot path (Blotevoetenpad) with wood, stones, chips, grass, loam and water sections, a labyrinth, and an 18m wooden watchtower; the experience lasts about 90 minutes and costs €7.50.
quote: close to 3 km and is only accessible barefoot ... wood, stones, tree chips, grass, loam and water ... 18-metre-high wooden watchtower ... entry fee is €7.50 ... lasts around 90 minutes

claim: Lieteberg visitor centre (Stalkerweg 46, 3690 Zutendaal) offers free parking; the walking area is accessible daily sunrise to sunset and the Butterfly Garden is open 1 May–30 September.
quote: Stalkerweg 46, 3690 Zutendaal ... parking is free ... daily from sunrise to sunset ... Butterfly Garden (Vlindertuin) is open from May 1 through September 30

claim: Thor Park (André Dumontlaan 67, 3600 Genk) offers 10 hiking loops including the 2km Steenmannetjespad and an 11km grey route, sits on 10 km² of former Waterschei mining land mixing slag heaps with heath and pine, and includes the Lichtsporen light-art trail.
quote: André Dumontlaan 67, 3600 Genk ... Steenmannetjespad: 2 km ... Grey walking route: 11 km ... 10 km² on former mining land ... Lichtsporen light art installation

claim: Pietersheim gateway in Lanaken is built around the 12th-century Waterburcht water castle on a 76ha former royal estate, with eight signposted hiking loops (four from the gate), a floating walkway accessible to less mobile visitors, and a petting zoo with playground.
quote: Romanesque castle ruin at the Pietersembos ... former royal estate 'Pietersheim' (covering 76 ha) features the 12th-century 'Waterburcht' ... eight signposted hiking loops, four of which start at the entrance gate ... petting zoo with playground

claim: 'Fietsen door de Heide' is a 4km bike path between cycle nodes 550 and 551 across the 700ha Mechelse Heide, with a nearly 300m wooden bicycle bridge giving a panoramic view over the heath; it opened July 2021 as the third Visit Limburg 'cycling-through' experience.
quote: bikepath of 4 km ... cycle nodes 550 and 551 ... 700 hectares one of the largest heathland areas in Flanders ... almost 300 meter long wooden bicycle bridge ... opened in July 2021

claim: Terhills (formerly Connecterra) is the main gateway and houses the National Park Visitor Center; trails climb three terrils (mine waste heaps) on the former Eisden coal mine site, with the green 3.6km loop reaching the Lange Terril panorama point.
quote: Terhills (formerly Connecterra, Maasmechelen) is the main gateway ... National Park Visitor Center ... three terrils (mine waste heaps) and shaft headframes ... green route of 3.6 km brings you in one hour over the long terril to the panorama point

claim: Hoge Kempen uses self-reliant year-round grazers — Norwegian Fjord horses, Konik horses, Angus cattle and donkeys — to maintain landscape variation, while the adjacent Rivierpark Maasvallei is grazed almost exclusively by Galloways and Koniks creating mosaic open grassland.
quote: Norwegian Fjord horses, Konikpaarden, Angus cattle, and even donkeys ... Along the Maas you see almost exclusively Galloway cattle and Konikpaarden ... mosaic patterns of open grassland and scrub

claim: The purple heather (Calluna vulgaris) at Mechelse Heide blooms from mid-August to mid-September, the peak visiting window for the signature purple-heath panorama.
quote: the purple heathland and expansive vistas are particularly beautiful in August and September

claim: All seven eastern Hoge Kempen gateways sit within 30 km of Opglabbeek by road: Mechelse Heide ~5 km, Station As neighbouring, Genk (Kattevennen, Thor Park) ~13 km, Maasmechelen (Terhills) ~15 km, Zutendaal (Lieteberg) ~10–15 km, Lanaken (Pietersheim) ~17 km.
quote: Maasmechelen to Opglabbeek: 15.5 km ... 18 minutes ... Genk and Opglabbeek is 8 miles ... De Mechelse Heide is located 4.97 km from Opglabbeek

claim: Fietsen door het Water sits at node 91 in Bokrijk (Bokrijklaan 1, 3600 Genk), where the path runs >200 m through a pond with water at eye level on both sides; reachable by Bokrijk train station.
quote: node 91... GPS coordinates 50.963069, 5.392711. The nearest address for parking is Bokrijklaan 1, 3600 Genk... more than 200 meters through a pond

claim: The Bokrijk pond path opened in April 2016 as a 200-metre-long, 3-metre-wide bike path through the De Wijers pond landscape.
quote: since its opening in April 2016, it has been a 200-meter-long and 3-meter-wide bike path where water reaches eye level on both sides

claim: Fietsen door de Bomen in Pijnven (Bosland) is at node 272: a 700-metre double helix with a 100-metre diameter rising to 10 m, opened June 2019, parking at Kiefhoekstraat 16, 3940 Hechtel-Eksel.
quote: 700 meters in total... double circle all the way up to the treetops, up to ten meters... node 272... was opened in June 2019... Kiefhoekstraat 16 in Hechtel-Eksel

claim: Fietsen door de Bomen is open daily from sunrise to sunset and is accessible to cyclists, walkers and wheelchair users; the park lists 8 suggested loops from the site.
quote: Fietsen door de Bomen is toegankelijk voor fietsers, wandelaars en rolstoelgebruikers van zonsopgang tot zonsondergang... 8 suggestielussen

claim: The Mechelse Heide bridge (294 m long) opened on 4 July 2021 and drew about 15,000 cyclists in its first week, signalling how busy these signature routes get; the route is in Hoge Kempen NP, not Hechtel-Eksel.
quote: de fietsbrug, geopend op 4 juli 2021... 294 m lang... gedurende de week na de opening, hebben ongeveer 15.000 fietsers het pad gebruikt

claim: Fietsparadijs Limburg is the regional rental network with pick-up points in Bokrijk, As station, Kattevennen, Hasselt, Houthalen-Helchteren, Zutendaal (Lieteberg) and Lanaken (Pietersheim) — Bokrijk rental is open daily 10:00–18:00 from 4 April to 8 November 2026 and stocks city, family, e-bikes, tandems and mobility scooters.
quote: Alken... As (Station As)... Genk (Bokrijk, C-mine, Fietspunt Station, and Kattevennen)... Lanaken (Children's Farm Pietersheim)... Zutendaal (Visitor Centre Lieteberg)... Rental hours for 2026 are from April 4 to November 8, Monday-Sunday, 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

claim: Visit Limburg's route planner offers themed loops that string two attractions together (e.g. Fietsen door het Water + Fietsen door de Heide), useful when riders want both in one day.
quote: Fietsen door het Water en Fietsen door de Heide

claim: Bosland publishes loops of roughly 34 km (nodes 248-05-517-516-515-258-257-272-255-254-256-247-248) and 62 km that pass node 272 from the Pijnven parking.
An accessible 6.3 km loop from junction 243 at Bokrijk's Castle parking takes riders to the 'Cycling through Water' span at node 91 on a 3-metre-wide path.
quote: 6.3 km accessible route starts at junction 243 (Parking 1 Castle) and features the famous 'Cycling through Water' experience at junction 91, where cyclists ride on a 3-meter-wide path

claim: Maasmechelen (Fietsen door de Heide gateway zone) is 15.5 km / about 18 minutes' drive from Opglabbeek, well within the 30 km radius from Slagmolen.
quote: The driving distance is 15.5 km with a driving time of 18 minutes

claim: Bokrijk open-air museum charges €17 adult, €3 child (3-12) and €37 for a family ticket (max 2 adults + 4 children).
quote: Adult (13-59): €17.00 ... Child (3-12): €3.00 ... Family (max. 2 adults + max. 4 children 3-12): €37.00

claim: Bokrijk opens daily 10:00–18:00 and is also open on Mondays during Flemish school holidays.
quote: Opening hours are 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM. On holidays and Mondays that fall during the Flemish school holidays, the museum is open.

claim: C-mine Expeditie in Genk is a 1.5-km route through the former Winterslag colliery's old air shaft, climbing to the top of Belgium's highest shaft tower.
quote: a one-and-a-half kilometre adventure ... feel, hear, see and experience ... Belgium's highest shaft tower

claim: C-mine Expedition tickets are €10 adult, €6 child (6-18), €8 senior, free under 6, with a €26 family pack.
quote: Adult (19-59 years): €10.00 ... Children (6-18 years): €6.00 ... Seniors (60+): €8.00 ... Young children (0-5 years): Free ... family package for €26.00

claim: The C-mine headframe is more than 60 m high and offers a panoramic viewpoint over the former miners' garden city.
quote: The authentic headframe on the square is more than 60 meters high ... A magnificent view of the green Limburg surroundings awaits those climbing to the top of the shaft tower.

claim: The Nationaal Jenevermuseum Hasselt opens Tue-Sun 10:00-17:00 and costs €10 for adults 26-65 (with a tasting drink included), free under 19.
quote: Tuesday - Sunday: 10 h - 17 h (last entry at 16.15 h) ... From 26 up to and including 65 years: €10 (including a drink) ... Up to and including 18 years: free admission

claim: Z33 is housed in a building by Italian architect Francesca Torzo with a diamond-shaped brick exterior, opened 2020 on the old beguinage site.
quote: The unusual building designed by architect Francesca Torzo plays with proportions, sightlines and light ... an unusual exterior of diamond-shaped bricks ... on the old beguinage site

claim: Z33's 2026 programme includes a major Raphaela Vogel commission for the Torzo wing plus solo presentations by Luca Vanello, gabi dao and Vibeke Mascini.
quote: first Belgian institutional solo exhibition of the German artist Raphaela Vogel ... major new commission developed specifically for the galleries of Francesca Torzo's exhibition building ... Luca Vanello (12.02-12.04), gabi dao (7.05-12.07) and Vibeke Mascini (23.08-25.10)

claim: Modemuseum Hasselt opens Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 with adult tickets at €10 (€8 over-65, €6 youth 12-26, free under 12).
quote: Tuesday – Sunday: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM ... Last admission at 4:15 PM ... Youth (12-26 years): €6 ... Adults: €10 ... Seniors (65+): €8

claim: Maaseik's renovated Schatkamer of Sint-Catharinakerk opens Tue–Sun 13:00-16:30 and showcases the Codex Eyckensis as the oldest illuminated manuscript in Belgium via a digital sensory display.
quote: Tuesday: 13:00-16:30 ... The oldest illuminated manuscript in Belgium ... a refreshing renovation in 2025 ... modern multimedia and interactive experiences

claim: A combination ticket covering Sint-Catharina treasury plus the Regional Archaeological Museum and Apothecary Museum costs €6 at Markt 45.
quote: Church admission in combination with the RAM (Regional Archaeological Museum) and the Apothecary Museum costs €6.00. Tickets are only available at the counter at Markt 45.

claim: Maaseik's Markt is a one-hectare tree-lined square ringed with 15th–18th century buildings and a 19th-century statue of native sons Jan and Hubert van Eyck.
quote: The Markt is the main square and true centre of Maaseik, featuring a 19th-century statue of the town's famous sons, Jan and Hubert van Eyck. The one-hectare market square has rows of trees along its edges and buildings dating from the 1400s to 1800s.

claim: Eisden Tuinwijk in Maasmechelen is a preserved British-style garden-city built 1910-1928 for the Limburg-Maas colliery, walkable on a 5-km interactive heritage trail.
quote: The oldest mining district of Eisden was built by the Limburg-Maas mining company between 1910 and 1928 ... has all the characteristics of a plagiarism of the 19th-century British Garden City ... interactive 5-km trek

claim: Slagmolen itself is a protected 1511-mentioned undershot oil watermill on the Bosbeek in Opglabbeek, restored in 1685 after Dutch War damage and protected since 1995.
quote: water mill in Opglabbeek on the Bosbeek ... This undershot mill, which functioned as an oil mill, was first mentioned in 1511 ... During the Dutch War (1672-1679) it fell into disrepair, but was restored in 1685. Since 1995, the mill has been protected as a monument

claim: Hasselt sits roughly 26–30 km by road from Opglabbeek (≈20-32 min drive), placing it at the edge of the 30-km radius.
quote: The distance from Hasselt to Opglabbeek is 26 kilometers via road, with a driving time of approximately 20 minutes ... 29.7 km with a driving time of 32 minutes

claim: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt 2026 tickets: children 85-99 cm €15, children ≥1 m from €24 dated (€32 undated), under 85 cm free, family pack 4 pers €105, 5 pers €125; family packs sold online only.
quote: Children (85-99cm): €15 ... Children (1m+): From €24 ... Under 85cm: Free ... Family Tickets (Online only) 4 people: €105 ... 5 people: €125

claim: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt is open daily roughly 10:00-17:30, with seasonal variation; tickets bind to a date and the hours calendar is on the site.
quote: Open today: 10:00 to 17:30

claim: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt is an indoor family park themed around Studio 100 characters (Kabouter Plop, Maya the Bee) with 25+ attractions; located in Hasselt ~26 km from Opglabbeek.
quote: more than 25 indoor and outdoor attractions for young and old

claim: Domein Kelchterhoef in Houthalen-Helchteren is free to enter; De Plas offers a 20 ha lake with sandy beach, water slides, pedalos, canoes, mini-golf and walking; supervised swim zone open 1 July-31 Aug 10:00-18:00 for free.
quote: swimming area with a sandy beach, water slides, playgrounds, canoes, water bikes, surfing, sailing, mini-golf

claim: Kelchterhoef features the 2.5 km Beestige Multimovopad with climbing, balance and water-play obstacles, plus a hangbrug, plankenpaden and the Joekel-style play forest free to use.
quote: het Beestige Multimovopad - een 2,5 km lange parcours vol natuurlijke hindernissen die uitdagen om te klimmen, balanceren en springen

claim: Lieteberg Zutendaal blotevoetenpad 2026: open daily 10:00-18:00 (last entry 16:20) from 16 March to 2 November; €10 adults/over 1.20 m, €6 children under 1.20 m, free under 3, carrier rental €5.
quote: Adults & children over 1.2m: €10 ... Children under 1.2m: €6 ... Children under 3 years: Free

claim: Lieteberg in Zutendaal is one of the official gateways (toegangspoorten) to Nationaal Park Hoge Kempen and houses the Hoes der Insecten insect knowledge centre and kabouterpad.
quote: Lieteberg - Nationaal Park Hoge Kempen

claim: Park Molenheide / Saraland in Houthalen-Helchteren has a subtropical pool with 4 large slides and a kabouterpool at 32 °C; 2026 day tickets €11.70 adult/€10.10 child weekday, €17/€16 weekend, family 2+2 €59.40, 2+3 €69.70 (weekend); open daily 09:00-20:00 (later weekends).
quote: Adults over 1.50m: €11.70 (weekdays) / €17.00 (weekends) ... Family (2 adults + 2 children): €59.40 (weekends only)

claim: Aquapolis at Park Molenheide is the subtropical indoor swim paradise inside the holiday park and is open to day visitors as well as guests.
quote: Vakantiepark met zwembad Aquapolis

claim: be-MINE in Beringen bundles the Avonturenberg climbing terril, mining museum, climbing hall, downhill MTB and Todi underground diving on the former colliery site, suiting families with older kids.
quote: underground diving in an old mineshaft, playing on the avonturenberg, climbing in the climbing hall

claim: The Avonturenberg at be-MINE is freely accessible every day from half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset; it is a 60 m former coal terril with poles, ropes and climbing nets.
quote: accessible every day, from half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset

claim: Mijnmuseum Beringen 2026: open daily 10:00-17:00 (ticket desk until 16:00); €4.50 for kids 6-18, free under 6; optional Ondergrondsimulatie €4 extra at 11:00/13:00/15:00.
quote: kinderen van 6 tot 18 jaar bedraagt de entreeprijs 4,5 euro, en kinderen jonger dan 6 jaar hebben gratis toegang

claim: Openluchtmuseum Bokrijk in Genk 2026: adult €17, child 3-12 €3, under 3 free, senior 60+ €13, family subscription €95; open-air museum runs 4 April-8 November 2026 Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00.
quote: Adults: €17, Children (3-12 years): €3 ... Family subscription: €95

claim: Cosmodrome Kattevennen in Genk planetarium 2026: adults €12, kids 4-12 €10, under 4 free; ticket covers planetarium show, exhibition and observatory.
quote: Children ages 4 to 12 years pay €10 per ticket, while adults pay €12

claim: Karting Genk in Genk (Damstraat 1) lets kids from 1 m 25 drive on the fun circuit alongside adults; outdoor track 11 km north-east of Opglabbeek.
quote: Al vanaf 1m25 kunnen kids zich uitleven in een huurkart

claim: Duinengordel in Oudsbergen/Opglabbeek is a ~3000 ha nature area that since 2020 is part of Nationaal Park Hoge Kempen with 82 km of marked trails across Oudsberg, Donderslag and Solterheide — free and on the doorstep of Slagmolen.
quote: Duinengordel - Wandelnetwerk met 82 km aan bewegwijzerde paden

claim: The Duinengordel access point sits at Speeltuinstraat in Opglabbeek/Oudsbergen and features the 12 ha Joekelbos adventure play forest with springbok course, suspension bridges and climbing forest, stroller-accessible.
quote: Joekelbos in Oudsbergen is 12 hectares and the country's largest adventure-style play forest

claim: Lommelse Sahara is a 200 ha free-access dune-and-lake walking landscape with three colour routes (3.1/5.9/11.8 km) and a 30 m observation tower; flagged here because Opglabbeek-Lommel is ~30+ km by road and Sahara itself is in the western tip of Lommel.
quote: 200-hectare sandy landscape with clear blue lakes in the middle of pine forests

claim: Road distance from Opglabbeek to Lommel city is around 44 km, putting the Sahara dune walk beyond the 30 km radius from Slagmolen.
quote: De afstand tussen Opglabbeek en Lommel

claim: Maasmechelen Village is open every day including Sundays from 10:00 to 19:00.
quote: Maasmechelen Village is open Monday-Friday from 10:00 until 19:00, and Saturdays and Sundays from 10:00 until 19:00. The designer brand boutiques are open every day, Sundays included.

claim: Maasmechelen Village hosts over 100 designer brand boutiques (BOSS, North Face, American Vintage, etc.) with up to 60% off.
quote: Over 100 Designer Fashion Brands with Up to 60% off

claim: Maasmechelen Village offers more than 1,600 complimentary parking spaces and opens Sundays/holidays except 25 Dec and 1 Jan.
quote: ample complimentary parking, with more than 1,600 spaces ... open on Sundays and public holidays except on 25 December and 1 January

claim: Hasselt has been the centre of the Belgian jenever industry since the 17th century; Hasseltse jenever carries protected geographical status.
quote: Hasselt has been at the centre of the jenever (gin) industry since the 17th century

claim: Jeneverfeesten Hasselt 2026 take place 17–18 October, with the Borrelmanneke fountain dispensing jenever instead of water.
quote: Jeneverfeesten ... 17 en 18 oktober 2026

claim: Wijndomein Aldeneyck in Maaseik farms 10 hectares on the southeastern Meuse slopes — the largest winery within day-trip range.
quote: Wijndomein Aldeneyck is located just a stone's throw from the cultural city of Maaseik, on the sun-drenched southeastern slopes along the Meuse

claim: Aldeneyck offers Friday and Saturday open tastings 10:00–18:00 on the terrace or in the wine lounge; reservations recommended.
quote: Every Friday and Saturday from 10 AM to 6 PM, you can taste the available Aldeneyck wines

claim: Aldeneyck has repeatedly been crowned Best Belgian Wine and took the Gault-Millau 2023 awards for Riesling 2019 (white) and Charles Pinot Noir 2018 (red).
quote: Aldeneyck wines have been repeatedly awarded the title of Best Belgian Wine ... Gault-Millau Belgian Wine Award 2023

claim: Wijngoed Pietershof, just on the edge of the 30 km radius, is a smaller estate whose Chardonnay was once named Best Belgian Wine.
quote: In 2006, his Chardonnay was named the best Belgian wine

claim: Brouwerij Cornelissen in Opitter (Bree) is a sixth-generation family brewery — formerly Sint-Jozef — brewing on 200-year-old copper kettles.
quote: King Mule IPA ... Cornelissen Luxury Lager ... Limburgse Witte ... Herkenrode Cister

claim: Cornelissen (renamed from Sint-Jozef in 2015) makes Ops-Ale, Limburgse Witte, Bokkereyer, Herkenrode and Gummarus and offers brewery tours with tasting.
quote: Brouwerij Cornelissen is a craft brewery with regional beers such as Ops-Ale, Limburgse witte, Bokkereyer, Herckenrode, Gummarus

claim: Achel lost its Trappist status in 2021 when the last monks left; the abbey and brewery were sold to entrepreneur Jan Torman and continue to brew Achel-branded beer.
quote: In 2021 the monastery closed ... and the abbey buildings and brewery were subsequently bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman

claim: The Achelse Kluis abbey site in Hamont-Achel offers guided brewery visits on Saturdays and Sundays at 13:30 or 15:30.
quote: Individual guided visits can be reserved on set times on Saturdays and Sundays at 1:30 PM or 3:30 PM

claim: Innesto in Zonhoven holds a Michelin star — chef Koen Verjans cooks modern cuisine in a stylish black-and-white room.
quote: Innesto holds a One Star rating in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide Belgium ... Chef Koen Verjans leads the restaurant in the open kitchen

claim: Cuchara in Lommel holds two Michelin stars in the 2026 Belgium guide — chef Jan Tournier serves quirky modern cuisine with Asian notes.
quote: Cuchara is a Two Stars restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Belgium

claim: Ogst in Hasselt holds a Michelin star; chef Sébastien Wygaerts cooks modern French with acidic, exotic touches.
quote: Ogst ... High quality cooking ... chef Sébastien Wygaerts impresses with fresh produce and attention to detail

claim: Kempisch Vuur is not a Cornelissen beer — it is brewed by Brouwerij Pirlot in Zandhoven (Antwerp province), outside the radius.
quote: Kempisch Vuur is brewed by Brouwerij Pirlot, located in Zandhoven

claim: Elaisa Energetic Wellness day entry costs EUR 65 weekdays / EUR 69 weekend, evening entry from 5 PM is EUR 49/53, with discrete-nude policy except swimwear on Wednesdays, Thursdays, first Saturday and third Sunday of each month; open daily 10:00-22:00.
quote: Weekday (Mon-Fri): EUR 65.00 day entry | EUR 49.00 evening (from 5 PM). Weekend (Sat-Sun): EUR 69.00 day entry | EUR 53.00 evening. Every Wednesday and Thursday, the first Saturday, and third Sunday of each month is swimwear day. Daily 10:00-22:00.

claim: Elaisa Energetic Wellness is located at Terhills in Maasmechelen on the edge of National Park Hoge Kempen and features 11 saunas (including Temazcal, Chakra balancing, ceremonial and infusion saunas) plus 8 baths including outdoor whirlpools and a Kneipp bath.
quote: Unique wellness facilities in Maasmechelen ... eleven saunas including a Temazcal, Chakra balancing saunas, a ceremonial sauna and various infusion saunas, along with eight baths including an energetic bath, a Kneipp bath and two outdoor whirlpools.

claim: Carbon Sense City Spa on the fifth floor of Carbon Hotel Genk is a 700 m2 wellness facility open to non-guests on weekends 10:00-19:00 with a EUR 19 Sense package (towels, slippers, bathrobe), swimwear mandatory; weekday hours Mon-Fri 15:00-22:00, weekend 10:00-22:00.
quote: Carbon Sense City Spa is a 700 m2 facility ... on the fifth floor of the Carbon Hotel ... Non-hotel guests can visit on Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Swimwear is mandatory! A day pass package costs EUR 19, which includes towels, slippers, and a bathrobe.

claim: Aquadroom Sauna & Wellness in Maaseik offers a full-day arrangement (often discounted via partners) giving unlimited access to all saunas, steam bath and rooftop terrace.
quote: A hamam arrangement for 2 persons is available for EUR 54.99 (regular value EUR 110), which includes a full day of unlimited access to all saunas, wellness facilities, steam bath and roof terrace.

claim: Aquadroom in Maaseik (Sportlaan 10, inside the Lotto Dome complex) operates a Sanarium, Loyly and Kelo sauna, Turkish steam bath, Garra Rufa foot spa, rooftop outdoor pool and ice hut.
quote: Sauna Sanarium, Sauna Loyly, and Sauna Kelo ... Turkish steam bath, foot baths, experience showers ... on the roof deck you can cool off and enjoy the sun in the outdoor pool ... you cool off afterwards in their ice hut.

claim: Aquadroom's adjoining swimming pool charges EUR 9.50 for adults 6-54 in the afternoon (EUR 7 for residents), EUR 5.50 for 55+, with a separately priced wellness/sauna section.
quote: Ages 6-54: EUR 9.50 (EUR 7 for local residents); Ages 55+: EUR 5.50. Entry Fees valid from January 5, 2026.

claim: Kajak Maasland in Lanaken/Maasmechelen rents kayaks and canoes for self-guided trips on the Maas to Maaseik, with a 13 km route taking 2.5-5 hours and a 21 km route via Negenoord and Bichterwaard for around EUR 25 per adult; open daily April 1 - October 31, reservation advised.
quote: Kajak Maasland offers kayak, canoe, and raft rentals on the Maas River from Lanaken/Maasmechelen, open daily from April 1st to October 31st ... a 3-person canoe costs EUR 25 per person ... The 13 km route takes 2.5 to 5 hours ... a longer 21 km route ... to near Maaseik.

claim: Thermae 2000 Valkenburg is around 28 km / 18 minutes by car from Maasmechelen, putting it roughly 40-45 km from Slagmolen in Opglabbeek - outside the 30 km radius but within easy day-trip reach.
quote: The distance from Maasmechelen to Valkenburg is 28 kilometers via road (including 24 kilometers via highways), and the route takes approximately 18 minutes.
